subject: Compact window proposal for transatlantic demo during DST mismatch week
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire@finport.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Compact window proposal for transatlantic demo during DST mismatch week

Hi Claire —

Quick note as we lock times for next week's demo: there's a one-week DST offset between the US and EU this year (US has already sprung forward; EU shifts at the end of the month). That creates a narrow set of overlapping working hours if we want both US and EU stakeholders live.

Options I want to surface for a single session that keeps it short and usable for APAC folks:
- Compact live window (45 minutes): 08:00 PT / 11:00 ET / 16:00 GMT / 17:00 CET — good for EU + US, tight for APAC (we propose recording).
- Two back-to-back micro-sessions (30m each): one aimed at US/EU, the second a repeat timed for APAC evening (we staff with recording + Q&A deferred).

Attached a trimmed agenda (demo-agenda-compact.pdf) that fits the 45m slot — focused product flow, 10m Q&A, and a quick checklist for piloting Redwood Dedicated. If you prefer two sessions I can propose exact slots and invite the right folks.

Can you confirm which you prefer by EOD? If neither works, tell us the best 60-minute window and we'll try to carve it out.

Thanks,
Tessa
Sr. Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: demo-agenda-compact.pdf (PDF, 72KB)

From: Claire Nguyen <claire@finport.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: FinPort Sales <sales@finport.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 16:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Compact window proposal for transatlantic demo during DST mismatch week

Thanks Tessa —

Appreciate the heads-up on the DST drift. The compact 45m window at 16:00 GMT works best for our core evaluation team (EMEA + a couple of US folks can join early). APAC will need the recording — can you confirm you'll share the recording and the slide deck?

If there's an option to run a follow-up 30m for APAC the next day that would be ideal, but not required.

Claire
Head of Partnerships, FinPort

P.S. Can we also get cost/performance ballpark numbers for a 2-week pilot during the call? We'll have procurement watching that closely.
